Game Overview

In Wasteland Wanderer, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a bleak wasteland where every choice counts. In Wasteland Wanderer, manage your resources meticulously, make impactful decisions, and leverage fame to enhance vital attributes. Survive the relentless environment while balancing Health, Hunger, and Sleep. Can you endure the unforgiving terrain beyond 30 days?
